//: The per-package template. A package's tsconfig.json is one line: { "extends": "../../tooling/tsconfig/package.tsconfig.json" } (apps add jsx, the DOM lib and the Next plugin). ${configDir} is the directory of the tsconfig.json that extends this, so include/exclude land in the package, not here. Add "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit" to the package's scripts: the root `pnpm typecheck` runs every package's.
//types: "types": [] so no ancestor folder's node_modules/@types (a stray one in the user folder, say) leaks into a workstation's type-check and hides a missing Node type that CI then finds (TASKS.md 4.2.e). A package that declares @types/node in its package.json adds "compilerOptions": { "types": ["node"] }; one that does not sees no Node globals, on Windows as on Linux.
